title: Species
description: A playable species: the body, the starting attribute shape and the innate traits (03-GAME-DESIGN §2.3, §4.2, §4.4; owned by docs/05-SPECIES.md). One file per species under content/species/<id>.json. The species' 'Cons' line is a trait too (its rule carries the speedBase, manaMultiplier or weak knobs), so the card can list it.

attributeMods.description: Added to 10 at creation (§2.3). The linter checks the net sum is +2.

traits.description: Innate rules. Each trait carries effect lines, a typed rule object, or both.

restrictions.description: Gear the species cannot use regardless of class: a weapon type, a slot, or a shield type.

darkvision.description: Reads the light band one step brighter for its own rolls (§4.2: Dwarf and Elf).

body.description: What the shared rig needs to build this species (11-ART-PIPELINE).

shapeKeys.description: Blend-shape names the species body uses on the shared mesh.

boneScales.description: Per-bone scale multipliers on the shared rig, bone name → scale (1.0 = human).

parts.description: Extra species meshes attached to the body (tusks, ears, tail, horns).

facePresets.description: How many face presets exist for the species.

gearVariants.description: Slots whose gear mesh needs a species-specific variant (a helmet over horns, boots over hooves).

creationBlurb.description: The sentence on the creation card.

chips.description: The three pros and three cons shown as chips on the creation card (§13).

effects.description: Effect lines applied to the hero permanently (buffStat, loot …).

rule.description: Typed knobs the sim reads directly (the 'Exact rule' and 'Cons' lines of docs/05-SPECIES.md §3). Multipliers are 1.0 = no change; point values are added; a trait carries only the knobs it moves.

speedBase.description: Replaces the 100 in the Speed formula (§2.2; Dwarf and Draconid 95, Elf Lightfoot 105).

xpMultiplierByAttribute.description: XP × this on actions tagged with the attribute (Orc: Wisdom-tagged 0.9), attribute → multiplier.

dodgeBonus.description: Flat Dodge in percentage points (Halfling Small +5, after the cap).

fortuneBonus.description: Flat Fortune in percentage points (§2.2; Halfling Lucky +5).

detectionByLightBand.description: Detection added in a light band (Orc: −2 in Radiant), band → points.

lightBandShift.description: Bands the species reads brighter (−1) or darker (+1) for its own rolls (§4.2 Darkvision); the loot bonus stays at the true band.

darkAccuracyImmune.description: Ignores the hero Accuracy penalty in Dark and Pitch (§4.2: Orc and Draconid).

armorPenaltyMultiplier.description: Scales the armor family's speed penalty (§6.1; Elf plate and mail 2.0), family → multiplier.

heavyWeaponStrengthExtra.description: Extra Strength over the requirement for weight-1,400 two-handers (Halfling +2).

ambushModifier.description: Added to the party's chance to be ambushed in percentage points (§4.4: Orcs are noisy, +5).

immunities.description: Statuses that never apply to the hero (Dwarf Stonefoot: root; Draconid Fireblood: burn).

forcedRowMoveImmune.description: Ignores knockback, pulls and enemy-forced swaps (Dwarf Stonefoot).

resist.description: Incoming damage multipliers below 1 by damage type (Dwarf poison 0.7, Draconid fire 0.5).

weak.description: Incoming damage multipliers above 1 by damage type (Draconid frost 1.25).

statusResist.description: Chance to resist a status being applied, in percentage points, signed (Dwarf poison +30, Elf fear −10), status → points.

statusDurationDelta.description: Turns added to a status's duration on the hero (Elf Lightfoot: web −1, root −1; minimum 1), status → turns.

appliedDurationMultiplier.description: Duration × this on statuses the hero applies (Orc Intimidating: fear 1.2), status → multiplier.

enemyAccuracyBySize.description: Accuracy penalty on single-target melee against this hero by monster size, in percentage points (Halfling Small: large −10, huge −15), size → points.

damageMultiplierBelowHpPercent.description: Damage dealt × multiplier while HP is below the threshold (Orc Bloodrage: 50 → 1.15).

fieldSkillBonus.description: Effective rank bonus on a field skill (Dwarf Forge-born: fieldRepair 2; Halfling Nimble Fingers: lockpicking 2, haggling 1), field skill → ranks; may carry the rank past 10.

fieldSkillStartRank.description: Starting rank of all eight field skills (Human Adaptable: 2; default 1).

trapDisarmRerollsPerFloor.description: Free re-rolls of a failed Trap Disarm per floor (Halfling Lucky: 1).

loadoutPresets.description: Saved loadout presets the hero may keep (default 2; Human Adaptable 3; the schema's ceiling is 4).

innateSkillId.description: A skill every hero of this species knows at rank 1, outside the loadout (Draconid Breath).

naturalArmorBase.description: Base Defense of a twelfth, unremovable armor piece that levels by hits absorbed (Draconid Scales: 8); the hero record carries it as naturalArmor.

fodderFlinchChance.description: Chance each fodder-role enemy loses its first action in a fight this hero opens (Orc Intimidating: 10).

restriction.description: Exactly one of: a weapon type (Dwarf: longbow), a slot, or a shield type (Halfling: tower; 'all' locks every shield).
